targets.title: Erdos Problem #196 — monotone arithmetic progressions in permutations
targets.prompt: Erdős problem #196. Must every permutation x of the positive integers contain indices i1<i2<i3<i4 for which x[i1],x[i2],x[i3],x[i4] form either an increasing or a decreasing four-term arithmetic progression? Retrieve the exact current primary statement and research status before working. Seek the strongest rigorous progress possible. Separate finite-prefix computation from the infinite assertion, test quantifiers and boundary cases, and do not claim a solution or novelty unless the unrestricted statement and current literature gap are both closed. Source identifier: https://www.erdosproblems.com/196.

audit_suffix: CANDIDATE AUDIT GATE: If a substantial candidate is produced, use the installed research-proof-audit skill and its strict file-backed contract before any promotion.
